session_summary: Blue title bar: 'High 2, Then Small Pullback Bull Trend'. Higher low double bottom at 5014 leads to High 2 buys and a minor wedge small pullback bull trend from the open; a close of body gap around 09:35, a 10 gap bar push to 5033 and a gap up to 5037 drive a buy climax at 5045 before late profit taking chops to 5042.
